original: Unrelated authenticated users could download private uploads.
reproduction: Reproduced before patch: unrelated learner received private bytes.
fix: Purpose/owner/membership authorization; deny unknown files, malformed paths and talent-resume bypass; random upload names.
verification: 7 security checks plus upload policy unit cases: anonymous 401, unrelated 403, enrolled/assigned 200.
limitation: Cloud storage and complete PostgreSQL talent consent lifecycle require staging.

original: Recovery and admin reset left old JWTs valid.
reproduction: Reproduced before patch; old session remained accepted.
fix: Bind sessions to persisted password hash; rotate current password-change session; validated recovery return destination.
verification: Both reset paths make old session return 401; destination recovery passes; unit rejection of unsafe destinations.
limitation: Rollout signs everyone out; real recovery inbox and Google provider flow unavailable locally.

original: Clearing optional profile values retained old data.
reproduction: Confirmed filtering of blank values in current route/store.
fix: Whitelist editable fields, accept explicit blank/null deletion, return canonical profile; separate marketing preference.
verification: Workflow test clears profile values and rejects role injection.
limitation: Historical promotional consent requires separate review.

original: Login, refresh and navigation lost the selected destination.
reproduction: Confirmed missing stable view URLs and login return path.
fix: Stable course/lesson/practice and dashboard view/task hashes; safe return through login/recovery; Back/Forward restoration.
verification: Desktop/mobile auth resume, Settings refresh, task refresh, course/filter Back/Forward and reset destination pass.
limitation: Coverage targets learning and dashboard views; embedded job/event detail selections are not all independently bookmarkable. Google callback needs provider verification.

original: Unsubmitted free and paid drafts disappeared.
reproduction: Reproduced editor rebuilding without local recovery.
fix: Account/task/language autosave, visible state, revision guard, flush before transition; drafts independent of attempts.
verification: Browser refresh/back/session expiry/account isolation and paid draft recovery pass; storage failure and stale-write unit tests pass.
limitation: Drafts are local to this browser/device; cleared storage cannot be recovered; conflicts need learner review.

original: Teacher could certify a nonmember or ineligible learner.
reproduction: Reproduced unauthorized recipient certificate before patch.
fix: Require course enrollment and actual course completion; remove bulk bypass; idempotent certificate issuance.
verification: Nonmember and incomplete member rejected with 400; certificate count unchanged; free required-assessment completion produces publicly verifiable certificate; certificate rule unit tests pass.
limitation: Existing certificates unchanged; full teacher completion UI and historical eligibility review remain staging/review work.

original: Failed requests left permanent loading screens.
reproduction: Confirmed assignment rejection and local talent 503 loader paths.
fix: Shared error boundary, plain unavailable state and Retry for dashboard loaders.
verification: Injected assignment 503 shows Retry; 100 survey records: 98 pass, 2 talent views show unavailable, zero recorded page errors.
limitation: Talent success flows need PostgreSQL; unavailable is a verified failure state, not a successful integration.

original: Skipped challan email advanced to sent.
reproduction: Confirmed markSent before an awaited provider outcome.
fix: Persist queued/failed/provider_accepted independently; await provider result; explicit retry and duplicate suppression; private receipt/download recovery.
files: registration-delivery.js; server.js; store.js; mailer.js; mail-provider.js; public/js/registration-status.js
verification: Local skipped SMTP returns recoverable 503 and never sent; mocked acceptance/retry/durable-write tests pass.
limitation: Real provider acceptance, inbox arrival and crash-after-send reconciliation remain unverified. Other legacy transactional email workflows are outside this specific fix.

original: Repeated registration created duplicate learner/offering records.
reproduction: Confirmed missing normalized registration identity.
fix: Reuse normalized email/offering registration; prospective unique DB guard; idempotent challan, clearance and enrollment.
verification: Concurrent local requests return one ID; repeat invoice, clearance and enrollment preserve one record and enrolled stage.
limitation: PostgreSQL index execution and multi-process races unverified; require one app instance. Existing duplicates deliberately retained.

original: Unknown offering codes were accepted.
reproduction: Confirmed arbitrary truncated codes could enter registration.
fix: Resolve published paid offerings and server fee; reject missing, unknown, free and inactive codes.
verification: Invalid/free/PATH API rejections and active/inactive offering unit cases pass; authoritative SC-01 fee 12500.
limitation: Stored historical invalid codes require review.

original: Teacher could award course gems to a nonmember.
reproduction: Reproduced before patch.
fix: Require actual batch membership and authorized teacher before award.
verification: Unenrolled synthetic student rejected with 400; rejection does not create award.
limitation: Historical mistaken awards need a ledger adjustment plan.

original: Quiz body batch_id overrode authorized URL batch.
reproduction: Original audit reproduced batch crossover; pre-fix rerun fixture skipped; code confirmed unsafe spread.
fix: Whitelist quiz fields; authoritative URL batch and actor; inspect analogous creation routes.
verification: Malicious other batch in body still creates quiz only in authorized batch 1.
limitation: This is a focused resource-ID review, not a formal whole-code security assessment.

original: Live navigation retained the Free-only filter.
reproduction: Confirmed stale cFree state.
fix: Reset mode-specific filters; preserve search/filter history and progressive course pagination.
verification: Desktop/mobile Free to Live and search pass; filter refresh and Back/Forward pass.
limitation: New browser/device opens default filters.

original: Coordinator tabs fetched admin-only sections; documented read-only chat was writable.
reproduction: Confirmed role/API mismatch and writable chat handler.
fix: Keep authorized read views; omit admin-only requests/actions; expose can_post and enforce read-only chat.
verification: Coordinator Teachers/Reports survey passes; read 200, chat write 403, admin instructor endpoint remains 403.
limitation: Role policy preserved from repository; no permission expansion.

original: Expired cohort dates, incorrect course counts and gem thresholds.
reproduction: Confirmed July/August campaign and stale 31/3 counts and stage bands.
fix: Remove expired urgency; derive counts and stage thresholds; distinguish self-paced free courses from paid live classes.
files: coursepages.js; public/landing.html; public/js/landing.js; public/open.html; public/js/open.js; server.js
verification: Catalogue inventory reports 39 offerings/10 free; source and rendered survey checked; current free course metadata self-paced.
limitation: Future campaign dates still need an owner and configuration process.

original: Failed grading stranded attempts and erased best grades/rewards on resubmission.
reproduction: Confirmed aggregate overwrite and missing durable worker/manual recovery.
fix: Independent attempt snapshots; bounded durable worker; visible failures/retry; admin recovery grading; preserve best aggregate and idempotent results.
files: learning-attempts.js; grading-worker.js; schema.prisma; schema-map.js; store.js; server.js; public/js/open.js; public/js/dashboard.js
verification: Local failure/manual completion for all 15 JS tasks; lower/failed resubmissions preserve 100 score and 570 gems; worker timeout/restart/retry-bound unit tests pass.
limitation: Live AI, PostgreSQL restart and real provider/file grading blocked. Single app/worker instance required; no distributed job lease.

original: Advertised PATH bundle generated a zero invoice and could not enroll.
reproduction: Audit reproduced zero invoice; incomplete configuration confirmed.
fix: Disable actionable PATH enrollment and reject server requests; preserve descriptive offer without inventing components.
verification: PATH registration/challan is rejected; valid paid lifecycle succeeds.
limitation: Bundle fulfillment is a business/configuration decision before re-enabling.

original: Average-based server completion disagreed with per-task UI.
reproduction: Confirmed mismatched policies.
fix: One server-owned required-assessment policy using each configured threshold; optional practice excluded; no empty-course or invented final exam completion.
verification: Mixed-score/per-task/optional/no-assessment unit tests; 15 of 15 JS assessments pass then certificate verifies publicly.
limitation: Existing certificates and grades unchanged; historical review separate.

original: Approve/reject/reapprove duplicated challenge rewards.
reproduction: Confirmed approval flag without reward reconciliation.
fix: Reference-linked reversible ledger deltas and idempotent corrections; block ambiguous historical correction for review.
verification: API correction ledger is +50,-50,+50; repeated approval adds nothing.
limitation: Do not auto-repair historical unreferenced rewards; reconciliation approval required.

original: Duplicate teammate aliases earned duplicate prizes.
reproduction: Confirmed repeated resolved user IDs in team array.
fix: Resolve and validate unique people, reject duplicate aliases; finalization awards each eligible member once.
verification: Duplicate aliases rejected; two valid members receive two awards; repeated finalization adds none.
limitation: Historical duplicate prizes unchanged.

original: Dialog focus remained behind overlay.
reproduction: Original screenshot/browser evidence; shared modal helpers confirmed.
fix: Focus entry, inert background, Tab containment and trigger restoration.
verification: Nine successive keyboard tabs remain in sign-in dialog; onboarding dismissal/resume passes.
limitation: Full screen-reader and all specialized dialogs not exhaustively tested.

original: Very long mobile catalogue with weak return/filter recovery.
reproduction: Original 12156px catalogue and lost filters.
fix: Load more after 12 offerings, result count, search/category recovery.
verification: 1440/390 search tests, <=12 initial cards, refresh and Back/Forward pass.
limitation: Free language groups retain existing card design.

original: Recommendation text ended mid-word.
reproduction: Confirmed string slicing in card summaries.
fix: Preserve full strings and use CSS line clamp with ellipsis/detail access.
verification: Source review and student overview screenshots at desktop/mobile.
limitation: Not an editorial rewrite of all course summaries.

original: Mixed hierarchy and unconfigured final-exam claims.
reproduction: Confirmed contradictory free-course labels/completion text.
fix: Course / Module / Lesson / Practice labels and named topics; actual assessment counts; contextual language/starter code.
verification: Free task workspace/browser journey and required-completion route pass.
limitation: Some paid/staff views retain Assignments/Quest terminology; a full cross-role vocabulary cleanup remains a design decision.

original: Learner errors exposed infrastructure configuration instructions.
reproduction: Confirmed raw unavailable responses in UI.
fix: Plain service error messages and Retry; authorized admin health retains diagnostics.
verification: Injected 503 and actual talent unavailable views show user-facing recovery copy.
limitation: Legacy third-party/rare handlers still require broader staging error injection.

original: Applicants had no receipt/status recovery after missed mail.
reproduction: Confirmed success-only registration flow.

verification: Registration workflow verifies bearer-only status, invalid token rejection, invoice identity and failed-mail recovery contract.
limitation: Real recovery inbox and complete applicant browser journey require sandbox mail.

original: Mandatory onboarding trapped users; promotions mixed with contact requirements.
reproduction: Confirmed locked contact form and no resume.
fix: Finish later, session-scoped form restore, Settings resume; explicit optional marketing choice.
verification: 390px finish-later/reopen preserves contact text; checkbox/profile preference persisted by allowed fields.
limitation: File selections must be chosen again; historical unspecified marketing consent is not retroactively rewritten.

original: Secondary mobile links had very small hit targets.

fix: Shared padded actions, 44px design target and readable mobile controls.
verification: 390px layout survey has no horizontal overflow; keyboard interaction passes.
limitation: Real-device touch, full target measurement and contrast audit remain unverified.

original: Admin health labels clipped and test-mode mail looked operational.

verification: Desktop/mobile admin screenshots and local unconfigured/test-mode state reviewed.

original: Learning destinations felt disconnected.

fix: Continue learning from student overview and clear access to free courses using shared session and stable URLs.
verification: Student overview screenshots and cross-portal lesson return tests.

verification: Onboarding browser test and registration lifecycle API contract pass.

verification: Ownership/history tests and failed/lower attempt preservation pass.
